name: Quick Temper
overview: Scripture warns against a quick temper, highlighting that those who are soon angry act foolishly and stir up strife, while the prudent and slow to anger demonstrate wisdom and self-control. A gentle response can defuse anger, whereas harsh words escalate conflict. The Bible esteems self-mastery over one's spirit as more powerful than conquering a city, emphasizing the strength found in patience and restraint rather than impulsive wrath.
